# MOLDIN.india®

> MOLDIN.india® connects good creators with brands across India. We manage curated creators manually by humans and execute entire brand campaigns strictly on timeline—having delivered 10+ brand campaigns this year with 35+ expected next year.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://moldin.in/): Overview of managed creator collective, full-campaign execution model, Nonstop Energy (100+ reels posted) and SunoSunao.ai (40+ reels posted) track record, and direct WhatsApp brand collaboration access.
- [Brands](https://moldin.in/brands.html): 100% human-managed campaign execution under strict timelines, past client case proof (Nonstop Energy 100+ reels, SunoSunao.ai 40+ reels, direct client references available), 10+ campaigns this year / 35+ expected next year, and direct brand brief intake.
- [Creators](https://moldin.in/creators.html): Featured 5:7 creator card deck led by Amlendra Kumar (626K followers, AI & Apps) and Sandesh Agrawal (88K followers, Tech & AI), active outbound brand outreach for managed talent, and direct inbound brand campaigns.
- [Blogs & Brand Playbooks](https://moldin.in/blogs.html): In-depth guides for brand founders and marketers on running full-scale multi-creator Instagram Reels campaigns in India.

## Verified Track Record
- 10+ full-scale brand campaigns delivered this year; expecting 35+ next year.
- Nonstop Energy campaign: 100+ reels posted end to end.
- SunoSunao.ai campaign: 40+ reels posted across curated creators.
- Managed verticals: Tech & AI, Consumer Apps, Fashion, Beauty, Fitness, Travel, and Modeling.
